name: YouTube Music (Google Cloud)
author: Helix
description: The fallback to the browser sign-in: needs your own Google Cloud project, and Google makes you sign in again every week while that project is in testing. Search YouTube Music, see your playlists and liked songs, and add their albums to Helix, through the official YouTube Data API. Play opens the YouTube Music app: Helix never copies YouTube's audio.

auth.setup: Needs a Google OAuth client of type "TVs and Limited Input devices" with the YouTube Data API v3 enabled. Put its client_id and client_secret in config.json under music_plugins.youtube-music-google.

settings.label: Search songs too
settings.description: Each YouTube search spends 100 of the project's 10,000 daily quota units; searching songs as well as albums spends 200.

settings.label: Region
settings.description: Two-letter country code that search results are ranked for, like AU. Empty uses YouTube's default.
